notes.title: 👻 ANOTHER PATCH
notes.notes:
This is the second patch in a week – we noticed many bugs and received a lot of feedback. Thank you very much for all the reviews you wrote, the feedback via the in-game feedback tool, and all the streams and videos showing the first gameplay! ☕

Special thanks to the following streamers & their communities – your feedback was really valuable to us:

[dynamiclink href="https://www.twitch.tv/daskninchen"][/dynamiclink]

[dynamiclink href="https://www.twitch.tv/roniini"][/dynamiclink]

[dynamiclink href="https://www.twitch.tv/eden_2_0"][/dynamiclink]

[dynamiclink href="https://www.twitch.tv/chaosgobliin"][/dynamiclink]

[dynamiclink href="https://www.twitch.tv/jaxboxchick"][/dynamiclink]


💀 PATCH NOTES 👻
⭐️ community feedback

🕯️ added

🔨 fixed

🎃 changed


Tutorial
🕯️⭐️ Hint box added when clicking on the bed now shows Saving & Daily Summary

🕯️⭐️ Hint box added for deliveries

🔨 Time stops during tutorial


Café
🕯️ Queue line collider added to prevent placing items

🕯️ Queue line slots increase per level

🕯️⭐️ Dirty cup slots on table increased from 6 to 14

🔨 Time continued after 10pm when reopening from pause menu

🔨⭐️ Level progression threshold lowered

🔨 Customers choose a random chair

🔨 Wrong customer dialogues while in waiting queue

🔨 Customers now sit between 30 and 200 seconds in the café

🎃⭐️ Higher flavour price values adjusted — Min 5 → Max 14 (Coffee Hot, Mild)

🎃⭐️ Customer spawn rate reduced (too many spawns)


Items
🕯️ Feedback animation added when pouring water from the kettle

🕯️ Feedback animation added when filling the coffee grinder

🔨⭐️ Delivery box items could not be put back

🔨⭐️ Only the base of the kettle was clickable after heating

🔨 Kettle outline not shown on stand

🔨⭐️ Missing info that kettle is heating up

🔨 Outline not visible when focusing an item

🔨 Excluded package preview on shelf

🔨⭐️ Filter sometimes stuck in hand

🔨⭐️ Cup remained in sink

🔨 Preview rotation of broom was incorrect

🔨 Broom rotation preview

🎃 Used candle light was too dark


Smogh
🕯️ Popup feedback added for clearer tutorial communication

🕯️ Speaking & idle animations added

🕯️ Visual cord added for lamp

🕯️⭐️ Smogh can now be attached to lamps

🔨 Early delivery of the coffee skipped tutorial section

🔨 Doesn´t react properly to coffee


UI
🕯️ Emergency button added to reposition player back in café after glitching out

🕯️⭐️ Brightness slider added

🔨 Duration text was not centered in progress bar

🔨 Computer GameSettings did not load correctly

🔨 Checklist Typo "Tiny Cup" changed to "Cup"

🎃⭐️ Pricing board slot price now shows hint that it applies to regular size

🎃⭐️ Online shop cart now closes automatically after ordering

🎃 Café name field made clearer for editing

🎃 Brightness default was loading incorrectly

🎃 Game selection description text made more readable

🎃⭐️ Computer screen now returns to overview when exiting

🎃 Removed “Return to Menu” button from computer


Miscellaneous
🔨⭐️ Controller sensitivity increased

🔨 Controller pause button was not assigned

🔨 Smogh Name Typo

🔨 Deposit Area placement area defined

🔨 Placing the deposit area on the same slot as before stopped Item spawning

🎃 Shop closing time changed from 8pm to 10pm

🎃 Global time stops at midnight



Along the way, many other small issues were fixed.



If you want to support the launch of the game – come join our Discord!

notes.title: 👻 DAY ONE PATCH
notes.notes:
A weekend has passed since the demo release and we are incredibly grateful for all the positive feedback. We already have over 200 plays of the demo and also surpassed the 1,000 wishlist milestone! Thank you so much. We’ve read your feedback and implemented the first changes into the game. Enjoy the patch. ☕


💀 PATCH NOTES 👻
⭐️ community feedback

🕯️ added

🔨 fixed

🎃 changed


Tutorial 
🕯️⭐️ Checklist: making coffee

🕯️⭐️ Checklist: café preparation

🔨⭐️ Tutorial softlock after completion


Dialogues 
🕯️ Option to disable dialog text animations added

🔨 Dialog speed slider inverted (fixed)

🎃⭐️ When skipping a dialogue, the full text is now shown first; another click moves to the next dialogue


Café 
🕯️ Daily revenue and tips are now shown on the day-change screen

🕯️ Sound for manual shop closing added

🕯️ Sound for automatic shop closing added

🕯️ Sound for shop opening added

🕯️ Sound for sign/board flip added

🕯️ Customer wait-time popup now changes to a house icon after closing

🕯️ Customers now point out excessively high prices

🔨 When the café is open, the “Open” sign now faces outward (fixed)

🔨 Text input on the specials board was not confirmed after leaving (fixed)

🔨⭐️ Repeatedly pressing ESC when leaving the specials board shifted the camera

🎃⭐️ Customer spawn rate reduced

🎃⭐️ Customer wait time increased

🎃 Customer wait time after closing significantly increased

🎃 Customer wait-time popup is now permanently shown after closing

🎃 Customers now point out slightly overpriced items with 100% probability


Online Shop
🔨 Deliveries arriving shortly before midnight are now scheduled for the next day instead of being rejected

🎃⭐️ Item descriptions are now easier to read


Items 
🔨 Item count overlapped the dialogue box (fixed)

🔨 The kettle now shows “hot” by default

🔨 Localization of “Trash can is full!” corrected

🎃⭐️ Colliders for ingredients and smaller objects enlarged for easier selection

🎃 “Remove” (control icon) renamed to “Take”

🎃 Item display adjusted


Miscellaneous 
🔨⭐️ When interacting with Smogh while running, the character kept running without stopping

🔨 English typos corrected

🔨 German typos corrected

🔨 Twitch name in the options menu corrected

🔨 ESC key did not work in submenus of the main menu



Many other small fixes were made that we can’t list here. Enjoy the first patch and keep brewing delightfully spooky coffee.



If you’d like to chat with other café owners – come join our Discord!
